newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips shares fall over five pct.
newsitem.headline: Philips shares fall over five pct.

text.p: Shares in Philips Electronics NV plunged 3.20 guilders or over five percent to 53.40 on Thursday after it announced lower than expected Q3 results and a one billion extraordinary charge in the final quarter.
Philips third quarter profits slipped to 123 million guilders in the third quarter from 539 million in 1995.
Analysts had expected third quarter net of between 240 and 360 million guilders. Some had expected Philips to take a third quarter charge to cover ongoing restructuring within the group.
